items.w1-mail-mia: Hi! I'm Mia. I work at the town library. We have a lot of comics and magazines. Come and read a story with me!
items.w1-mail-leo: Hello, neighbor! I'm Leo. The plaza is old and dirty. Can you help me fix it? I need some wood and two crops.
items.w1-talk-leo: What do you want to grow on your farm?
items.w1-quest-mia: We will have a reading party soon. Please bring two carrots for the snacks.
items.w1-story-mia: Mia shows you an old book. "This book has no title," she says. "It is a story about a happy farm." "Can you give it a title?"
items.w1-story-mia_say: Let's call it The Happy Farm.
items.w2-mail-leo: Thank you for your help! I was nervous about the plaza, but now I feel calm. You are a lovely neighbor.
items.w2-mail-mia: I'm sorry I was not at the library yesterday. I felt unhappy and wanted to be alone. Today I'm glad again!
items.w2-talk-mia: Do you want to hear a joke?
items.w2-quest-leo: My friends are coming to the plaza. Please bring two potatoes. We will cook together and laugh a lot.
items.w2-story-leo: Leo is shouting at a broken chair. Then he stops and smiles. "Sorry, I was angry," he says. "Shouting does not fix chairs. Friends do."
items.villager_Mia: Hi, I'm Mia. I'm the town librarian. I love quiet rainy days and a good story. I'm a little shy, but I always want to hear about your day.
items.villager_Mia_motto: Every book is a new friend.
items.villager_Leo: Hello! I'm Leo, the town carpenter. I can fix almost anything with my hammer. I get angry fast, but I say sorry fast too!
items.villager_Nora: Good morning! I'm Nora, the baker. I get up very early to make bread. Please come and eat with me!
items.arrive_Nora: Hello, neighbor! I just moved to your town. My son Ben will join me soon. I opened a small bakery by the plaza. Come and try my bread!
items.villager_Ben: Hey! I'm Ben. I'm twelve years old. I love soccer and music. One day I want to play the drums on a big stage!
items.arrive_Ben: Hi! I'm Ben, Nora's son. The plaza looks so cool now! Can we build a stage? I want to play the drums there.
items.villager_Sam: Hello there. I'm Sam. I travel from town to town and sell things from far away. This town is lively now, so I want to stay a while.
items.villager_Sam_motto: A fair price makes everyone happy.
items.arrive_Sam: Hello! This town looks happy. Can I park my cart here? I want to open a market here one day.
items.task_p1-wood: I need four pieces of wood. I will make a long table.
items.task_p1-weeds: There are so many weeds! Can you help me pull them?
items.task_p1-stone: Please bring three stones. I want to fix the old wall.
items.task_p1-carrot: Working is hard. Let's eat some carrots! Can you bring two?
items.task_p1-flowers: The plaza looks sad. Could we put some flowers here?
items.task_p2-stone: Let's make a stone path. We need five stones.
items.task_p2-carry: These stones are heavy! Help me carry them, please.
items.task_p2-rice: I want to make rice cakes for everyone. Please bring three bags of rice.
items.task_p2-potato: Potato bread is my favorite. Can you bring two potatoes?
items.task_p2-lantern: At night the plaza is too dark. Two lanterns will help.
items.task_p3-wood: We need six pieces of wood to build a stage.
items.task_p3-drums: Let's get ready for the show! Help me set up the drums.
items.task_p3-bench: People need a place to sit. Can we get a bench?
items.task_p3-carrot: I'm making carrot cake for the party. I need three carrots.
items.task_p3-flowers: Flowers make everyone smile. Can you bring two more flowers for the stage?
